qr.heading: New cheque capture
qr.warning_share: Do not share it: it grants upload access to this batch.
qr.close_confirm_body: The QR will stop working. It is the only way to invalidate a code that is already printed.
qr.worker_down: Batch created, but the QR worker did not answer. Use the link, or retry.

session.title: Batches
session.select_carrier: Pick a carrier to see its batches.

review.title: Review
review.all_settled_hint: Every cheque in this batch is settled or matched outright.
review.confirm_body: Cheque {cheque} will be tied to shipment {shipment}. It is recorded as a manual decision, permanently.
review.none_unassigned_hint: Every cheque already has a shipment. Clear the filter to see the rest.
review.open_shipment: Open the shipment in a new tab

guidance.cash_return: An AS document: the money came back in cash and there is no AWB to match on. Pick the shipment by hand.
guidance.return_match: Found via the carrier's return leg (document = AWB+1). It is derived: confirm it before it counts.
guidance.ambiguous: More than one shipment carries that AWB. The carrier's AWB is not unique: pick which one.
guidance.not_found: No AWB of this carrier matches. Check the document in the capture, or pick the shipment by hand.

suggest.title: Choose the shipment
suggest.exactly_one: Exactly one shipment fits. Confirm it yourself anyway.
suggest.none_hint: No shipment of this carrier has that amount within the date window.
suggest.manual_hint: Search by AWB, LDV or shipment id
suggest.pick_one: Pick a shipment or type its id.
suggest.note_from_candidates: Chosen by an ERP operator from the candidates (amount + dates).
suggest.note_typed: Shipment id typed by hand by an ERP operator.
suggest.search_hint: Type at least 3 characters to search
suggest.none_inline: No candidate by amount and date. Use search for AWB, LDV or id.

rematch.title: Re-run the matching?
rematch.body: Looks for each cheque's shipment again. What a person already decided is left alone.
rematch.carrier_hint: Matching only looks at this carrier's shipments.
rematch.carrier_warning: Changing the carrier repoints the batch. The QR and the photos stay valid.

approve.title: Approve the batch?
approve.body: Settled cheques move to their shipments' record. Anything still needing a decision stays here. If the cheques do not add up to the invoiced COD it is reported: the invoiced amount is not changed.
approve.divergence: Shipment {shipment}: invoiced {expected}, cheques {got}. The invoiced amount was NOT touched — take it up with the carrier.

queue.title: Pending
queue.subtitle: Batches needing you, across every carrier.
queue.empty_hint: No batch is waiting on a decision or an approval.
queue.delete_body: Batch #{id} (bill {bill}) and all its cheques will be hidden. Cheques already approved onto a shipment are NOT reverted. Reversible by an administrator.

export.title: Export COD distinta
export.subtitle: Generate a CSV of a client's COD cheques over a date range, one row per cheque.
export.note_rows: One row per cheque: a shipment with several cheques appears several times.
export.range_required: Enter a date range (from / to), or a bill number.
export.range_hint: The date range is required, unless you give a bill number.

collect.title: Mark shipment {id} as collected
collect.confirm_body: Shipment {id} will be recorded as collected on {date}. This changes its COD state.

assign.title: Assign to remittance report
assign.confirm_body: {count} shipments will be assigned to report {report}. This cannot be undone from here.
